caption: The drawing depicts a single classical column placed centrally on a plain background. The column is composed of three main parts: a rectangular stepped base, a fluted shaft, and a decorative capital. The base consists of multiple square layers, each smaller than the one below, stacked to form a solid foundation. The shaft is vertical with evenly spaced grooves running from the base up to the capital. The capital at the top of the column is ornate, featuring a series of rounded, petal-like lobes arranged in a symmetrical pattern, with smaller round elements forming rings at intervals. The entire column is rendered in varying shades of light purple and lavender, with shading that suggests soft lighting and gives the structure a sense of three-dimensionality. The background is off-white, and there are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Candlestick
